title: TOC entry shows stray text when a heading contains an HTML tag with ">" in an attribute value
spec:
This is the Python-Markdown library (Python 3, no dependencies). Run the tests with `python3 run_tests.py`.

With the `toc` extension, a heading with inline HTML whose quoted attribute contains `>` gets a garbled TOC name and id.

```python
md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc'])
md.convert('# <abbr title="Python > 3">Python</abbr> support')
print(md.toc_tokens[0]['name'], md.toc_tokens[0]['id'])
```
EXPECTED: name `Python support`, id `python-support`.
ACTUAL: name `3">Python support`, id `3python-support`.

Similar inputs are probably affected too; please fix the underlying problem rather than just this case.
acceptance: The heading above yields TOC name `Python support` and id `python-support`.
Existing TOC tests still pass (`python3 run_tests.py`).
